svg.title: Central rack, network and power boundaries
svg.text: LARP / TEAM CIRCUIT COMPLETION / 07
Central rack, network and power boundaries
Your 8U layout can fit the following allocation only after enclosure depth, equipment height, airflow and mounting are checked. The team BOM lists a 9U cabinet.
U8 / Exhaust / ventilation panel
U7 / CAT6 patch panel
U6 / Managed PoE switch - PoE-capable SKU required
U5 / Router / firewall - restricted control network
U4-U3 / Vented 2U shelf: mini PC / central application / database
U2 / 230V-compatible rack UPS for network / server load
U1 / PDU / socket distribution - matching site voltage
Data path
LPR cameras + gate controllers -> managed switch
Mini PC serves API, apps and SQLite over Ethernet
PoE/data -> compliant splitter -> flow controller
Flow controller -> RS-485 -> eight bay controllers
Bay controllers -> ceiling sensors and RF lock nodes
Database / demo boundary
public.sqlite: identities, entitlements, controller registry
Core circuit session: runtime memory; reconnect after restart
scaled.sqlite: separate capacity-model demo
Docker named volume retains files across normal restart
SQLite is sufficient for this single-host demo
Hardware access goes through the API, not direct DB writes
Power corrections / pending checks
WS-C2960S-24TS-S in BOM does not provide PoE
SMART500RT1U in BOM is a 120V UPS
Do not connect a 120V unit to a 230V supply
Parking motors require separately sized protected power
Rack UPS runtime does not establish motor backup runtime
Mains protection / bonding are installation design work
8U allocation: 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 8U; no spare space. A 9U cabinet provides one additional rack unit.
Central application: /central | User: /app | Security: /security | Connected circuit: /circuit/ | Native 3D: /?view=three
BENCH / MODULE REFERENCE - not a certified safety circuit or fabrication-ready PCB. See wiring schedule and design notes.
GPIO maps: ESP32-WROOM-32E DevKitC. The team WT32-ETH01 requires its own pin-map review. Motor current and field safety remain unverified.
